title: John Lennon settles lawsuit with Allen Klein’s ABKCO | 1975
content:
John Lennon settled his lawsuit with Allen Klein’s ABKCO on 4 April 1975.

ABKCO Industries Inc v John Lennon had been settled out of court, but a stipulation of discontinuance was issued today by the Supreme Court of New York, formally ending the dispute.

Klein had sued Lennon on 6 July 1973. Similar lawsuits were also filed against Harrison, Apple Records, and Apple Films. Klein was seeking to recoup money from loans and advances that they received during the time of Klein’s management.

On 1 November 1973 Lennon, Harrison and Starr countersued, alleging that ABKCO had breached its fiduciary duties, and that the 8 May 1969 business contract was no longer valid as the former Beatles did not fully understand it, and as a result ABKCO was not entitled to its commission.

Lennon paid ABKCO a sum of $135,000 as a final settlement, and the counterclaim was withdrawn. Lennon was given until 26 May to pay the amount.
